'''Panoram''' is an NPC at [[Energy Hub]], [[The Black Shores]]. He's a Gardener from the Black Shores alongside with his sister, [[Paranora]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Panoram}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Panoram''': Hello there. Can I help you with something?
:{{DIcon}} You and that Gardener I just met…
:{{DIcon}} Para... Pano...?
:'''Panoram''': Haha, that's my sister, Paranora. We're both Gardeners.
:'''Panoram''': People often mix up our names, so sometimes her documents end up with me.
:'''Panoram''': My sister handles the talent pool, and I focus on finding the right people from that pool to form the support teams.
:{{DIcon}} Support teams?
:'''Panoram''': Exactly. The support teams monitor the Waveworn, issue alerts, and then dispatch pre-organized action teams to assist various countries in preventing potential disasters.
:'''Panoram''': Of course, this requires cooperation from those countries. We need to be granted the right to collect and analyze Reverberations in their local disaster zones.
:'''Panoram''': Good cooperation is crucial for our work's success and will be a huge benefit to them as well.
:'''Panoram''': After all, disaster prevention is just as important as disaster relief.
----
:;(During the quest [[To the Shore's End]]; [[Advance toward the Future from Today]])
:'''Panoram''': Are we really challenging Tethys when it's on locked down?
:'''Panoram''': It'll be a miracle if we can even pull it off, but...
:'''Panoram''': With the Shorekeeper helping us within Tethys and our comrades fighting bravely on the frontlines...
:'''Panoram''': It's a gamble, but losing isn't an option.

{{Dialogue End}}
